translations./garage/brief: RO-1 estimates motion from wheel encoders and a yaw-rate sensor. Compare how tire contact and IMU quality change the estimate.
translations./prediction/heading: Is Position Still Accurate After the Wheels Slip?
translations./prediction/hint: The estimated path in the AI view comes from wheel motion; the body follows the simulated ground contact.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: Wheel rotation always matches body travel
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: On slippery ground, wheel rotation does not guarantee the same distance the body travels.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: Position error accumulates along the route
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Record your prediction. Press Tab during the run to compare estimated and actual position in the AI view.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: I’m estimating my position from wheel motion.
translations./running/detected_line: RO-1: Environment sensing is online; the position estimate keeps updating.
translations./debrief/success_summary: The gap between actual and estimated paths reveals odometry drift.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Use better traction and a lower-bias IMU, or reduce speed before trying again.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: The debrief error is the difference between wheel odometry and actual position.
translations./debrief/failure_titles/collision-static: Mission failed: collision after localization drift
translations./debrief/failure_titles/timeout: Mission failed: calibration pad not reached
